plugins.name: p-wiki
plugins.description: Persistent markdown knowledge wiki under docs/wiki/, stored on the filesystem (default) or in Confluence Cloud, with optional one-way primary→mirror sync (pwiki sync). Skills: init, ingest, compile, query, lint, reconcile, sync.

plugins.name: p-flow
plugins.description: Task development flow for Claude: secrets deny-list, Conventional Commits + <type>/<slug> branches, spec templates, brainstorm → plan → execute → TDD → verify → debug → review → push pipeline (review skills dispatch general-purpose with inline reviewer templates). Commands: init, task-start, task-end. Skills: using-p-flow, init, task-brainstorming, writing-plan (TDD-aligned or generic), executing-plan, test-driven-development, verification-before-completion, systematic-debugging, requesting-code-review, requesting-task-review, receiving-code-review, using-git-worktrees, writing-skills. Optional bridges to p-tasks, p-wiki, p-graph when present. Discoverable via SessionStart hook.

plugins.name: p-tasks
plugins.description: Task tracker (task → sub-task) with FS and Jira destinations, one-way sync. CLI `ptasks guard` answers "is there work?" as a p-shed guard (exit 0 launch / 75 quiet, --exclude-origin skips items parked on a human), reusing next's selection rules. Skills: init, add, set, next, summary, list, sync.

plugins.name: p-statusline
plugins.description: Custom Claude Code status line (context, rate limits, git, RAM). Skills: install.

plugins.name: p-graph
plugins.description: Local code knowledge graph (TS/JS, Go, C++, Python). pgraph CLI indexes symbols + call/import/extend edges into SQLite; query with search/node/callers/callees/impact/trace/context. Skills: init, sync, help, query.

plugins.name: p-shed
plugins.description: Scheduler/launcher for Claude Code headless runs: cron-scheduled `claude -p` launches with timeout, duplicate guard, catch-up, and log rotation. Per-job guard command gates each launch (0 launch / 75 quiet / else breaker), and its last stdout line is kept as the reason `status` shows. Speed profiles make pace one word: a `profiles:` table in jobs.yml, an active name resolved from PSHED_PROFILE / a file outside the scheduled repo / defaults.profile, applied in memory by tick, status and run alike. Maintenance windows via `deploy`. Skills: init, start, stop, job, reset-breaker.

plugins.name: p-observe
plugins.description: Zero-touch realtime observability: watches p-shed/p-tasks/p-graph/p-wiki runtime state and emits a normalized human-readable event stream (pobserve watch/status/capture/tui). Skills: init, watch, tui, help.

plugins.name: p-chat
plugins.description: Dumb Telegram channel for Claude Code loops: a p-shed job guard + pchat CLI (init, guard, pending, ack, send, reset, status). Scripted /commands answered without Claude; free-text questions trigger a Claude responder launch via p-shed. Zero deps. Skills: init, respond.
